correctness.rationale: PASS: For rank-one positive 2×2 A, det[[A,u],[vᵀ,z]]=−γ independent of z. If γ=0 exact ReLU rank 2; else exact rank 3 and no finite negative cap achieves zero loss. With N=adj(A)ᵀ and η=vᵀAᵀu>0, t=−γ/(B||A||²+η) gives rank-two latent witness with error t²||A||², yielding upper coefficient γ²/||A||². For any o(1) near minimizer, eight strictly positive entries force latent perturbations O(1/B), determinant identity gives B|det(A+H)|≥|γ|−O(δ), while |det(A+H)|≤||A||δ+δ²/2, matching lower bound; monotonic inversion gives εBmin→|γ|/||A||. Independent exact SymPy 27 cases confirm rank/determinant witness; X=[[1,1,1],[1,1,2],[1,2,0]] coefficient 1/4.
